source.description: B2B ecommerce development for manufacturers, distributors and B2B2C brands. ERP integrations, portals, replatforming and rescue. 200+ specialists.
source.content:
B2B customer portals
Give business customers secure self-service access to account-specific catalogs, contract pricing, order history, invoices, quick ordering, and repeat purchases.
Elogic Commerce is a B2B ecommerce development company for complex, ERP-connected B2B and B2B2C systems. We build, replatform, integrate, rescue, and support commerce for manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and hybrid B2B2C brands.
We work across Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce Cloud, and commercetools, with ERP, PIM, CRM, OMS, WMS, PunchOut, and EDI

We are typically the strongest fit for mid-market and enterprise businesses where platform choice, integrations, and delivery quality have a material business impact. Learn why Elogic Commerce is the safe choice for complex B2B and enterprise ecommerce – from structured discovery and milestone governance to post-launch optimization and support.
Deep experience in industrial manufacturing and building materials (Armacell), apparel and lifestyle (Buff), electronics and equipment (HP), specialty and pet distribution (PetHQ), and licensed consumer brands (Disney).
Elogic Commerce is a commerce engineering partner for organizations where platform decisions, system integrations, and delivery governance have a material impact on revenue and operations.
Founded in 2009, we work exclusively in ecommerce - with deep specialization in complex B2B, B2B2C, and integration-heavy environments, including multi-country global rollouts for international enterprises.
Our clients are mid-market and enterprise manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and hybrid B2B2C businesses. They come to us when the work is too complex for freelancers, and too focused for global consultancies.

We use AI-assisted engineering for analysis, QA, migration, and optimization where it improves delivery. Architecture, security, code review, and release decisions remain engineer-led.

We work exclusively in ecommerce. No mobile apps, no marketing campaigns, no generic IT outsourcing. Every engineer, architect, and project manager has deep commerce platform experience.
Too complex for freelancers? Too focused for a global consultancy? Elogic Commerce delivers enterprise-grade commerce engineering with specialist teams, structured governance, and accountable delivery - without the overhead of a global network.
We have delivered production integrations with SAP S/4HANA, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle ERP Cloud, Infor, Epicor, Salesforce CRM, Akeneo, and Pimcore - engineering bidirectional data flows that keep pricing, inventory, and orders accurate across systems.
Every project follows a structured delivery framework: defined discovery, milestone-based delivery, RACI accountability, change management controls, and transparent progress reporting. Our approach is documented in our public Risk Register (/risk-register/). NPS 70, measured post-launch.
